تفاديت (form VI)
# تَفَادَيْتُ (tafādaytu) /ta.faː.daj.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَفَادَى (tafādā)
# تَفَادَيْتَ (tafādayta) /ta.faː.daj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَفَادَى (tafādā)
# تَفَادَيْتِ (tafādayti) /ta.faː.daj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَفَادَى (tafādā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
